question: BVR Subrahmanyam was appointed as the ________ in February 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**CEO of NITI Aayog**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BVR Subrahmanyam** was appointed as the **CEO of NITI Aayog** in February 2023.
 
• The **National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog)** is a policy think tank of the Government of India, established with the aim to foster involvement and participation in the economic policy-making process by the State Governments of India.
 
• NITI Aayog provides both directional and policy inputs, and it designs strategic and long-term policies and programs for the Government of India and also provides relevant technical advice to the Center and States.
 
• As the CEO of NITI Aayog, Subrahmanyam is expected to lead and coordinate the efforts of the institution in various developmental and policy initiatives.
 
• Prior to this appointment, BVR Subrahmanyam has held various key positions in the Indian administration and has a rich experience in governance and public administration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI Aayog** was established on **1st January 2015**, replacing the Planning Commission of India.
 
• The primary objectives of NITI Aayog include fostering cooperative federalism, promoting sustainable development, and enhancing the involvement of States in the policy-making process.
 
• NITI Aayog operates through a structure comprising the Prime Minister as the Chairperson, a Governing Council, a Vice-Chairperson, and other full-time and part-time members.
 
• The institution is instrumental in the formulation of various strategic and long-term policies and programs for the economic development of India.
